tfb01_lwalls.note: It is an interior wall in three bands, and the old patterned wallpaper, red rail and green boards go. The upper half becomes smooth, warm off-white painted plaster with only the faintest roller texture. The narrow band across the middle becomes a simple flat pale grey rail. The lower part becomes plain light grey wall panelling with a slim dark grey skirting board along the very bottom edge. The bands stay at the same heights.

tfb01_furnish2.note: It is a pale grey-oak laminate cabinet: the left part is a plain side panel, the right part its front, two drawers above a door, with brushed steel handles. The thin red outlines become fine dark shadow gaps between the drawers and the door.

tfb01_shpflr1.note: Dark brown wood plank flooring, the boards running from top to bottom, matte, lightly worn.

tfb01_door2.note: Two plain materials side by side, with the split where it is: on the left, pale grey-brown wood with a fine vertical grain; on the right, smooth blue-grey painted metal with faint wear.
